cnica.MIOParams#

class cnica.MIOParams(params=<factory>, max_outer_loop_iters=10, max_inner_loop_iters=1000, max_line_search_iters=50, tol=1e-08, gamma=0.02, initial_lr=0.1, filter_half_order=10, filter_max_lag=10, lam=100.0, sparsity_gate_threshold=0.7)[source][source]#

Bases: object

Parameters for the MIOptimizer Riemannian refinement stage of CNICA.

params#

Three flags selecting which derivative orders to include in the mutual information objective: (0th, 1st, 2nd). At least one must be True. Default is (True, True, False) for 0th and 1st order only.

Type:

tuple

max_outer_loop_iters#

Number of barrier cooling steps.

Type:

int, default 10

max_inner_loop_iters#

Maximum Riemannian descent steps per fixed mu.

Type:

int, default 1000

max_line_search_iters#

Maximum backtracking steps per descent iteration.

Type:

int, default 50

tol#

Convergence tolerance on the duality gap.

Type:

float, default 1e-14

gamma#

Pruning fraction for near-origin points.

Type:

float, default 0.02

initial_lr#

Initial step size for backtracking line search.

Type:

float, default 0.1

filter_half_order#

Half-order of the Parks-McClellan FIR derivative filters.

Type:

int, default 10

filter_max_lag#

Maximum autocorrelation lag for unsupervised filter tuning.

Type:

int, default 10

lam#

Sparsity regularization strength.

Type:

float, default 10.0

sparsity_gate_threshold#

Sigmoid gate midpoint for the sparsity norm.

Type:

float, default 0.5
